title: Common Errors
markdown:
| Message or symptom | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| "The code execution cannot proceed because X.dll was not found." | The DLL, or one it depends on, is not next to the program or anywhere in the search order | Ship it next to the `.exe`; check `dumpbin /dependents` | 1.02, 4.01 |
| "The procedure entry point F could not be located in the dynamic link library X.dll." | An older or different X.dll was loaded that lacks F | Find which file was loaded (Modules window, Process Monitor); never remove exports | 1.05 |
| "The application was unable to start correctly (0xc000007b)." | A 32-bit DLL in a 64-bit process, or the reverse | Build every module for the same architecture | 1.02 |
| `LoadLibraryW` returns NULL, error 126 | Module not found, often a dependency of the DLL you named | Dependencies tool; `LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DLL_LOAD_DIR` for plugin folders | 2.03, 4.02 |
| `LoadLibraryW` returns NULL, error 193 | Wrong architecture, or not a DLL | `dumpbin /headers` | 2.03 |
| `LoadLibraryW` returns NULL, error 1114 | `DllMain` (or a global constructor) failed | Move work out of DllMain into an init function | 2.04 |
| `GetProcAddress` returns NULL | Name decorated because `extern "C"` is missing, or wrong case | `extern "C"`; check `dumpbin /exports` | 2.01 |
| `LNK2019 unresolved external symbol` for a DLL function | Not exported, or the import library is not linked | Add the export macro; link the `.lib` | 1.03, 1.05 |
| `LNK2038 mismatch detected for '_ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL'` | Debug and Release code linked together | Build all modules in the same configuration | 2.06 |
| `LNK2019 __delayLoadHelper2` | Delay loading without `delayimp.lib` | Link `delayimp.lib` | 4.03 |
| "Run-Time Check Failure #0 - The value of ESP was not properly saved" | Calling convention mismatch (32-bit) | Put the convention in the function pointer typedef | 2.02 |
| Heap corruption or a crash when freeing a DLL's memory | Freed by a module with a different CRT heap | Let the DLL free what it allocates | 2.05 |
| The program hangs while loading a DLL | Waiting on a thread or lock inside DllMain (loader lock) | Explicit init and shutdown functions | 2.04 |
| Crash after `FreeLibrary` | A function pointer, string, vtable or object from the DLL was used after unloading | Drop every pointer before unloading | 2.03, 5.03 |
| The link fails with "cannot open file" during hot reload | The loaded DLL or its PDB is locked | Load a copy; give each PDB a unique name | 5.03 |
| State jumps or garbage after a hot reload | State kept in DLL globals, or layout changed | Host-owned memory; version and migrate state | 5.04 |
| A different copy of the DLL is loaded on another machine | Search order found a copy on PATH or in the current directory | Full paths, `SetDefaultDllDirectories` | 4.01, 4.02 |
| The program needs `MSVCP140D.dll` on a user's machine | A Debug build was shipped | Ship Release builds with the redistributable | 4.04 |
